question: Why do the divisions of Śiva become innumerable?
premises: Each unit is declared to be five-faced.
The system is already divided into ten and eighteen.
Further subdivision by faces multiplies the divisions.
inference: Because each division is itself five-faced, the ten-and-eighteenfold scheme expands into innumerable divisions.
plain_english: Since each is declared to be five-faced, what is divided into ten and eighteen becomes innumerable through further divisions.
